name: Yakimochi Kanojo no Ichizu na Koi
original_name: ヤキモチ彼女の一途な恋
source:
Aoba is a member of cooking club and is always harshly treated by Iori, another member of the club. People in Aoba's surroundings clearly see through Iori's motivation being love, but Aoba doesn't notice it at all until after a year, Iori confesses and demands to have sex with him. On top of that, after the act itself she demands for him to forget about it.

Next, a junior who looks up to Aoba, Mio, also joins the cooking club and Aoba also gets involved in ecchi happenings with Mayuko, a teacher. All of it makes Iori grow more and more jealous.

Aoba spends difficult time in the cooking club along with the three.
translation:
葵是烹飪社成員，總是受到另一名成員伊織的苛刻對待。周圍的人都清楚看穿了伊織這麼做是因為喜歡葵，但葵直到一年後伊織向他告白並要求和他發生關係，才終於意識到這一點。事後，她還要求葵把這件事忘掉。

後來，仰慕葵的學妹澪也加入了烹飪社，葵還和老師麻由子發生了一些色情事件。這一切讓伊織越來越嫉妒。

葵和這三人一起度過了烹飪社裡艱難的日子。
